comparisons.name: get-light-capsule
comparisons.description: As get-light with the title and the caption masked, to score the capsule alone: both are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: get-dark
comparisons.description: GET with its In-App Purchases caption on the dark page, where the capsule keeps its light fill, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: get-dark-capsule
comparisons.description: As get-dark with the title and the caption masked, to score the capsule alone.

comparisons.name: price-light
comparisons.description: The price $14.99 in the second lockup column, Aqua.

comparisons.name: price-light-capsule
comparisons.description: As price-light with the price masked, to score the capsule alone: the price is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: price-dark
comparisons.description: The price $14.99 in the second lockup column, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: price-dark-capsule
comparisons.description: As price-dark with the price masked, to score the capsule alone.

comparisons.name: rest-light
comparisons.description: Both variants at rest on the App Store's page: the tinted capsule's fill and the filled variant's blue, Aqua.

pixels.note: capsule fill (spec: store-pill-button, Capsule fill, measured)
first device pixel of the capsule at mid height: no border, the fill starts at the box's edge (spec: Border, none, measured); the tolerance covers the antialiasing of the tangent pixel
page just outside the capsule (spec: Page behind, measured)
filled variant: the capsule takes the title's blue, which is measured; that the confirmation step looks so is inferred (spec: States, confirm)

comparisons.name: rest-dark
comparisons.description: Both variants at rest on the App Store's dark page: the tinted capsule keeps its light fill, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: capsule fill, unchanged in Dark Aqua (spec: Capsule fill, measured)
page just outside the capsule (spec: Page behind, measured)
filled variant: the title's dark blue, measured on the title's stems (the spec's reading is #0885ff); the look of the confirmation step is inferred

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: The tinted button while the mouse is held down on it: the whole control at half opacity, Aqua.

pixels.note: the measured fill #f2f2f7 at 50% over the white page; the dimming is inferred (spec: States, pressed)
the other button is not dimmed

comparisons.name: pressed-dark
comparisons.description: The tinted button while the mouse is held down on it: the whole control at half opacity, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: the measured fill #f2f2f7 at 50% over the page #1e1f22; the dimming is inferred (spec: States, pressed)

comparisons.name: pressed-filled-light
comparisons.description: The filled button while the mouse is held down on it, Aqua.

pixels.note: the measured blue #027aff at 50% over the white page; both the filled look and the dimming are inferred
the other button is not dimmed

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the tinted button, reached with Tab: the ring follows the capsule, Aqua.

pixels.note: the shared focus ring colour, measured on the Go to Folder field (spec: focus-ring), over the white page; that this control shows the standard ring is inferred (spec: States, focused)
the ring above the capsule's top edge
page just outside the ring: it ends 2.5 pt beyond the capsule's edge (spec: focus-ring, Geometry)
page outside the rounded end: the ring follows the capsule, not its bounding box
the fill is unchanged by focus

comparisons.name: focus-ring-dark
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the tinted button, reached with Tab, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: the shared dark focus ring colour, measured in Automator (spec: focus-ring), over the page #1e1f22; inferred as above
page just outside the ring

comparisons.name: window-inactive-light
comparisons.description: Both buttons in an inactive window, with keyboard focus on the first: grey replaces the blue and there is no focus ring, Aqua.

pixels.note: no focus ring in a window that is not key (CONTRIBUTING, Window state)
filled variant without the blue; provisional: the library's rule for accent colours, no screenshot shows the store inactive
the tinted capsule's fill does not change

comparisons.name: window-main-dark
comparisons.description: Both buttons in a window that is main but not key, with keyboard focus on the first: grey replaces the blue and there is no focus ring, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: no focus ring in a window that is not key (CONTRIBUTING, Window state)
filled variant without the blue; provisional, as in window-inactive-light

comparisons.name: progress-light
comparisons.description: The downloading state, Aqua: a ring a quarter filled around the stop square. No screenshot shows a download; the look is provisional.

pixels.note: the stop square in the store's blue (--mac-store-pill-button-tint)
the page between the square and the ring

comparisons.name: progress-forced-colors
comparisons.description: The same in forced-colours mode: the stop square keeps a system colour, ButtonText, and does not vanish into the page.

pixels.note: the stop square in ButtonText, which Chromium's forced-colours emulation draws black on a light page
